disclosure: Six matched GPU conditions each contain 1,000 complete steps and twelve raw timing pairs from the shared frozen input corpus. The 1,024 by 1,024 shallow-water samples include software power capping under the recorded configured and enforced power policy. Per-condition clock, power and event summaries are retained. Every elapsed-time value is unchanged.

measurement_protocol.rate_unit: million complete interior-cell updates per second
measurement_protocol.rate_range_definition: observed minimum and maximum of useful_updates / each raw seconds value
measurement_protocol.range_interpretation: Observed extrema of twelve individual rates; these ranges are not confidence intervals.
measurement_protocol.pairing: The repeat index and original within-pair implementation order are retained.
measurement_protocol.timer_scope: One complete ordered device graph replay, including every required numerical stage and state publication
measurement_protocol.physical_update: A shallow-water update includes all three fields, both time stages and periodic boundaries. An energy-balance update includes both time stages and pole copies.
measurement_protocol.precision: Ordered binary64 arithmetic with contraction and fast-math disabled; canonical output agreement is checked outside the timer.

toolchain.build_command_policy: Executable names and source publication aliases replace installation-specific paths; measured source and binary hashes are unchanged.

power_policy.benchmark_policy: The native benchmark did not set power limits or clocks. Recorded samples include automatic clock and power management.

quiet_policy.allocation: One owned exclusive node; only the current numerical step and the declared idle batch step are allowed.
quiet_policy.placement: The host driver is pinned to CPU1 and NUMA node0; the selected GPU UUID is fixed.
quiet_policy.post_sample_observation: GPU process ownership and host load are checked after each timed graph; the full observations remain in the hashed timing evidence.
quiet_policy.clock_and_power_management: The native benchmark did not set power limits or clocks. Recorded samples include automatic clock and power management.
quiet_policy.acceptance: All six retained conditions have accepted exclusive-node and quiet-sample flags; automatic clock or software power-cap events are disclosed separately.

provenance.local_artifact_policy: Paths under .runtime and .agents identify retained local evidence. This public JSON includes identities and summaries, not binaries, input containers, logs or full per-sample observations.
